verdict.rationale: Requesty's own docs say each API key or service account can have its own monthly spend cap, which delivers per-key budgets. Service accounts separate spend from users, but nothing shows team-level or per-user caps, or what happens when a cap is hit. missing for 10: documented per-team and per-user budget scopes, explicit hard-stop enforcement behavior when a cap is reached, non-monthly budget periods, independent/hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can set hard budgets and spend limits per key, team, or user

citations.quote: Each API key or service account can have its own monthly spend cap.
spend from those keys will not be tied to any user.
